offering_description.value: Butler National makes aircraft modifications, avionics and flight systems for aircraft makers, militaries and operators, and provides aircraft maintenance. It also owns and manages casino and hospitality operations, including Boot Hill Casino in Dodge City, Kansas, and manages a tribal casino.

primary_products.value: aircraft modifications; avionics and flight displays; aircraft control systems and structural components; special mission aircraft

primary_services.value: casino operations; casino management for tribal casinos; aircraft maintenance and repair; hospitality and food service

customer_segment.value: B2B: aircraft manufacturers, airlines, charter operators, tribal casino owners; B2G: military and government agencies buying special mission aircraft and avionics; B2C: casino and hospitality guests

end_markets.value: aerospace and defense; business aviation; gaming and casinos; hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: avionics, aircraft components and modified aircraft; service fees: aircraft maintenance and modification work; transaction or usage fees: casino gaming revenue from wagers and hospitality sales; commissions or management fees: fees for managing tribal casinos
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds avionics and aircraft components from purchased parts, sold to aircraft makers and governments; service provider: aircraft modification, maintenance and casino management for customers; asset operator: owns and operates casino and hotel facilities serving the public
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: aerospace customers worldwide, casinos in Kansas and tribal casino management in Oklahoma and elsewhere in the US

specialization.value: diversified: aerospace products and services plus casino and hospitality management, with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: aerospace products and services sold directly to manufacturers, operators and governments; own locations: owned casino and hotel properties serving guests

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FAA certification of aircraft modifications and avionics, state and tribal gaming regulators license casinos
